description: Per category (treasury tokens, staking, private credit, yield stablecoins, reinsurance, stablecoin pools, fixed rate), the tokens an AI agent can buy on its own whose stated yield is highest right now — with a risk level 1-5 next to each, the purchase route (DEX pool, deposit contract, Pendle market), contracts and the page. Categories are ordered from low to high risk. Ranked by yield under printed rules, not recommended. Use it for "what looks good this week" or "top tokens a bot can buy".

max_risk.description: Leave out picks above this risk level (default 5)
